children: Tenon Medical completed a private placement raising approximately $2,999,404.59 through a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor, issuing pre-funded warrants for 597,610 shares at $5.019 per warrant and Series A warrants for 1,058,517 shares with a $5.02 exercise price. The Series A warrants are immediately exercisable and expire in five years; pre-funded warrants carry a $0.001 exercise price. Ownership caps limit post-exercise holdings to 4.99% for Series A and 9.99% for pre-funded warrants. Proceeds will support debt repayment, working capital, and general corporate purposes; WallachBeth Capital acted as exclusive placement agent with a 7% fee, and Tenon agreed to register the resale of underlying shares on an expedited timeline.
